heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: SAML tokens used as authentication credentials MUST be signed. In addition, a valid SAML token MUST include the following assertions:

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The SAML token MUST use the saml:NameID assertion for the LWS subject identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The SAML token MUST use the saml:Issuer assertion for the LWS issuer identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The SAML token MUST use the Recipient parameter within a saml:SubjectConfirmationData assertion for the LWS client identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: Any audience restriction in the SAML token MUST use the saml:Audience assertion. The saml:Audience assertion SHOULD include a client identifier and any additional target audience such as an authorization server.

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: Using a trust relationship with an issuer, the signature of the credential MUST be validated as described in SAML Core, section 5 [[!SAML2-CORE]].

heading: Token Type Identifier
text: A SAML 2.0 assertion used as an authentication credential MUST use the urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:saml2 URI when interacting with an authorization server.
